selection_rule: lowest mean masked tuning MAE over horizons 3,6,12; exact ties prefer earlier candidate
strategy: one global pooled-sensor direct regressor per scored horizon; no recursive predicted lags
feature_order: 12 standardized own-sensor lags oldest first, 12 observed flags, origin daily sin/cos and weekly sin/cos, one-hot synthetic sensor position
artifact_policy: local-only synthetic model JSON, preprocessing/feature schema JSON and aggregate experiment JSON; no raw rows or windows
